# Data Source: identitynow_parameter

Use this data source to look up a parameter in parameter storage by ID or name. Only the public fields are returned, the private fields are never available.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_parameter" "db_credential" {
  name = "Database service account"
}
```

Exactly one of `id` and `name` must be set.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Parameter ID. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Parameter name. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the parameter.
- `last_modified_at` (String) Date any field of the parameter was last changed.
- `last_modified_by` (String) ID of the user who last changed the parameter.
- `owner_id` (String) Identity ID of the parameter owner.
- `primary_field` (String) Name of the primary field in the public fields.
- `private_fields_last_modified_at` (String) Date the private fields were last changed.
- `private_fields_last_modified_by` (String) ID of the user who last changed the private fields.
- `public_fields_json` (String) Public fields of the parameter as a JSON object.
- `type` (String) Parameter type.
